Watching everyone—especially the bride—glow with excitement while the henna slowly dries would be a beautiful reminder of how traditions weave us together. I’d probably spend a good chunk of the evening chatting with cousins, swapping stories, and maybe even trying my hand at a simple henna pattern (though I’m not sure I’d be any good at it!). What was your favorite part of the night? Did you get to try any special henna designs or enjoy any particular dish that made the evening extra memorable?
